content: The wiki has no controls page. The valid button names are probably the standard ones for this harness: "left_click"/"right_click", or "mouse_left". Let me try a small probe set — but each failed probe costs a step. Better: try the most likely canonical pair in one plan, and if the first works the rest of the plan proceeds.

args.approach: Try canonical button names left_click/right_click (and mouse_left as fallback) on the notice board, then use left_click to till/plant/water the meadow soil.
